scope: Full user thread: original 18-section specification, repeated automation/OSINT/cipher requests, expanded tool specification, UI corrections and expanded pasted dossier. This is a gap register, not a claim of completion.

items.requirement: Bulletin board first; clear breakdown directly underneath
items.remaining: Evidence board is default; case breakdown and dossier verification are directly below the real canvas. Browser-tested.

items.requirement: Every case thread exposes connections, exact proof and saved analysis
items.remaining: Original case threads plus the EU project are accessible under the board; unsupported connections remain flagged.

items.requirement: Analysis/collection tabs open on automatic results, with optional configuration
items.remaining: 12 tabs tested; not every method is automatically applicable

items.requirement: Show every uploaded dossier claim with independent verification state
items.remaining: All 141 claim units have source-coverage assessments: 3 supported, 10 partly supported, 128 not verified. Missing originals are not fabricated.

items.requirement: Clickable PDF pages, original photographs and source passages
items.remaining: Original PDF and image bytes hash-verified through private HTTPS access

items.requirement: Cork/dark themes, saved graph layouts, graph navigation, undo/redo
items.remaining: Implemented; complete feature-by-feature acceptance not rerun in current audit

items.requirement: Thousands of entities: clustering, collapse, lasso, spatial search and performance benchmark
items.remaining: Virtualized visible canvas exists; full scale/cluster acceptance remains unverified

items.requirement: Dedicated cards and full inspectors for every requested media/entity type
items.remaining: PDF/image/text/code/media support exists; complete 13-card acceptance not established

items.requirement: Persistent original-file acquisition, retries, rate limits, hashes and visible failures
items.remaining: Actual public source jobs queued and processed; per-site failures retained

items.requirement: Recurring research/cron with pause, resume, cancellation and durable progress
items.remaining: Persistent research workers and a new 15-minute official-source watch run. Full restart/cancel matrix not rerun in this audit.

items.requirement: Browser acquisition, resumable transfers, archive fallback and availability monitoring
items.remaining: HTTP/archive acquisition exists; every requested browser/resume/provider scenario not validated

items.requirement: Legally acquired originals, immutable vault and derivative separation
items.remaining: Source/derivative integrity and sandbox tests in existing regression artifacts

items.requirement: Import all prior SQLite databases, manifests, source files and conflicting reports
items.remaining: Supplied dossier imported; unavailable prior user files cannot be presumed recovered

items.requirement: Live X/Twitter feeds and comprehensive historical feed analysis
items.remaining: No authorised X API credential; imported public archives supported; all-feed coverage not claimed

items.requirement: Live onion research and preservation through Tor
items.remaining: Current environment has no configured Tor transport/network access

items.requirement: Every existing photograph on the web and hidden/missing-file recovery
items.remaining: Growing bounded corpus; exhaustive internet coverage and inaccessible files cannot be certified

items.requirement: Public disclosure/leak research without private-account/access-control bypass
items.remaining: Public-source scheduled discovery exists; no private or unauthorised collection

items.requirement: Continuously growing file/database/search collection with actual originals
items.remaining: Live worker heartbeats, preserved originals and extraction/search records

items.requirement: PostgreSQL for all case records, Neo4j graph and Qdrant semantic index
items.remaining: Postgres gateway, Elasticsearch/Qdrant and SQLite case vault; Neo4j migration not implemented

items.requirement: Temporal graph, entity resolution, communities, paths and contradiction discovery
items.remaining: Source-backed graph analytics exist; automatic identity resolution and broad contradiction discovery remain incomplete

items.requirement: Keyword/BM25, semantic search and graph traversal in one natural-language interface
items.remaining: Search adapters exist; all natural-language examples not accepted end-to-end

items.requirement: Durable specialist investigator tasks with tool receipts, dependencies and failures
items.remaining: Durable workflows and bounded tool execution; specialist-agent roles are not all independently demonstrated

items.requirement: Independent red-team, scientific review and evidence-auditor conclusions
items.remaining: Citation auditing and competing hypotheses exist; independent scientific/model validation incomplete

items.requirement: At least 200 individually verified AI features and functions
items.remaining: Callable catalogue is not 200 distinct AI agents; model/deterministic/operational counts must remain separate

items.requirement: Claude API, local Ollama and optional external model adapters
items.remaining: Local model works; external adapters need configured credentials and separate validation

items.requirement: Source dependence, information-gain collection, cognitive-bias controls and retained dissent
items.remaining: Several structured methods exist; full automatic fusion and calibration not completed

items.requirement: PDF extraction, OCR, metadata, page coordinates and originals
items.remaining: Existing sandbox/forensic tests and real acquired PDF previews

items.requirement: Image OCR, EXIF, channels, hashes, differences, diagnostics and comparisons
items.remaining: Actual saved image reviews exist; universal authenticity/hidden-image detection not claimed

items.requirement: Video/audio transcripts, scenes, frames, waveform and spectrogram
items.remaining: Processing paths exist; full requested real-media end-to-end acceptance incomplete

items.requirement: Static repository/binary analysis, disassembly, blame, embedded resources
items.remaining: Static text/code analysis exists; full Ghidra/LIEF/YARA-X/firmware workflow incomplete

items.requirement: Isolated unknown-file parsing; unknown binaries require approval to execute
items.remaining: No acquired code execution; resource/network/read-only guards retained

items.requirement: Scientific validation of steganography/edit/face-identification claims
items.remaining: Heuristic indicators remain provisional; biometric identity matching is not asserted

items.requirement: Automatic decoding using existing engines rather than per-item manual selection
items.remaining: CyberChef Magic and typed automatic profiles exist; bounded candidate search, not universal decryption

items.requirement: Gematria/Grimatria mappings, Scrabble, classical ciphers and reproducible recipes
items.remaining: Saved calculations and mappings exist; every proposed method still needs method-specific acceptance

items.requirement: Negative controls, transformation counts, holdout tests and multiple-testing discipline
items.remaining: Controls exist; complete statistical validation across every method/corpus remains incomplete

items.requirement: Break all modern encryption or prove messages from readable/numerical coincidences
items.remaining: No such completion claim is permitted

items.requirement: Caltech/JPL biography, IJK, Fluid Synchrony, C2, graduation and public attribution
items.remaining: Named Caltech caption acquired; expanded biographical assertions need individual primary support

items.requirement: Bohrdom/First Law/Steam depot/binary and historical metadata comparisons
items.remaining: Steam metadata/artwork/archives preserved; unreleased builds and binary-change assertions not verified

items.requirement: Mondaloy patent family, inventors, priority dates, citations and claims
items.remaining: Original patent PDFs and catalogue records acquired; identity merges and technical-performance claims require separate proof

items.requirement: EU Time Machine versus physical time travel and Quantum Flagship
items.remaining: Official CORDIS grant and project site acquired; digitisation purpose and EPFL coordination source-backed; broader connections remain unverified.

items.requirement: Henry Martinez post, timestamp, historic ownership and purported prediction
items.remaining: Identifier-format time is reproducible; post text/ownership/pre-event meaning not authenticated

items.requirement: Proposed scientist roster, deaths/disappearances and alleged common research team
items.remaining: Supplied roster is secondary, includes fifteen names; common team not established

items.requirement: Criminal complaint, affidavit, docket/transcripts, plea and court audio/video
items.remaining: Actual official DOJ complaint and affidavit acquired and attached. Supplied CourtListener pages returned 403; original hearing audio and incident video not acquired.

items.requirement: AI-fake claims, original image attribution and repeatable forensic conclusions
items.remaining: AFP fact-check and comparison originals preserved; independent authentication of every named fake not completed

items.requirement: Interactive timeline with separate publication/capture/retrieval dates and uncertainty
items.remaining: Existing timeline works; all uncertainty/zoom/prediction examples not accepted end-to-end

items.requirement: Source-backed public geospatial events, historical overlays and lawful routing
items.remaining: Public source-linked map exists; historical overlays and route analytics incomplete

items.requirement: 500 individually source-verified executable tradecraft methods
items.remaining: Executable methods, guided techniques and reference families are distinct; no 500-method completion claim

items.requirement: CIA/NSA/public doctrine, knowledge-graph patents and validated implementation
items.remaining: Some primary references acquired; full patent-method implementation/benchmark not established

items.requirement: DNA, ballistics, toxicology, interviews and physical laboratory techniques
items.remaining: Cannot be implemented as validated laboratory conclusions from unrelated public webpages

items.requirement: Actual-file ZIP, manifests, hashes, JSON/CSV and case reports
items.remaining: Export code exists; every requested PDF/DOCX/GraphML/GEXF/high-resolution board format not fully accepted

items.requirement: Authentication/RBAC, audit hash chain, secrets outside source and origin guards
items.remaining: Existing controls and tests; enterprise SSO/MFA/dependency/security certification not complete

items.requirement: Backups, recovery, storage budgets and persistent always-on deployment
items.remaining: Supervisor and snapshots exist; off-host recovery/reboot-independent private relay not fully deployed

items.requirement: Working private HTTPS access to actual originals and application
items.remaining: Owner-private relay is workspace-dependent; must remain running

items.requirement: Apple Silicon Mac dependency install, start-up and acceptance on user Mac
items.remaining: Current environment is Linux; no access to or verification on the user Mac

items.requirement: Upload current source to GitHub, as subsequently requested
items.remaining: Current source uploaded and verified. This does not establish full platform completion or upload the evidence vault.

items.requirement: Flawless, exhaustive future prediction and all-world-method coverage
items.remaining: Finite tests and source coverage do not establish these universal claims
